source.name: World Rugby Shop: Springboks 26/27 Replica Home Jersey by Nike (official product page)
source.quote: Sponsors FNB sublimated on the front and Pick n Pay on the back
source.note: The product photos on the same page show the large gold FNB logo centre chest. SA Rugby announced FNB as front-of-shirt sponsor in March 2025 (SportsPro, 27 Mar 2025: 'FNB logo will feature on the front of all matchday jerseys, including men’s and women’s Springboks').

source.name: SA Rugby: Pick n Pay joins SA Rugby family of partners
source.quote: Pick n Pay has signed a four-year contract as a Tier 1 sponsor of SA Rugby, with the company’s logo set to feature in gold on the back of the Springbok jersey
source.note: Confirmed on the 2026/27 shirt by the official product listing (World Rugby Shop: 'Sponsors FNB sublimated on the front and Pick n Pay on the back') and by its product photo showing 'Pick n Pay' in gold on the upper back.

source.name: World Rugby Shop: Springboks 26/27 Replica Home Jersey by Nike (official product page)
source.quote: Stand behind the Springboks in the official Springboks 2026/27 Replica Home Jersey by Nike.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Nike's own product page (nike.com/za, style IB6784-331) describes the shirt as 'Inspired by the Springboks' 2026/27 home shirt'.

summary: Nike makes the Springboks' green 2026/27 home shirt, with FNB's gold logo centre chest on the front and Pick n Pay's gold logo on the upper back. The official product listings and photos show no other commercial marks: the left sleeve carries the South African flag badge (not a sponsor), the rest of the back is plain, and the replica home shorts carry only the Springbok crest and the Nike swoosh.
